reference: Pam is dressed as Olive Oyl, which only makes sense next to Popeye, and Jim refuses to put on his Popeye costume (he's 'never really been a costume guy'); Dwight mistakes her costume for his mother. Jim finally appears as Popeye at the end (holding Cece).

evidence.line: Dwight: Looks like someone decided to dress up as old Dwight Schrute's mom. ... Pam: I'm supposed to be Olive Oyl. And it makes more sense when I'm standing next to Popeye, but... Jim doesn't want to put his costume on.
Jim: I've never really been a costume guy. ... when Pam hands me this little number [holds up Popeye costume, shakes head] ...no.
Jim: [holding Cece] Spinach in a can. Power eat spinach. [Popeye sound] Pam: Aww, my hero!

caveats: Main cause required: Olive Oyl without Popeye because Jim won't wear his costume. The Dwight's-mom line and Jim's final Popeye appearance are supporting points. That Jim wears Popeye at the end is inferred from his line and the direction 'Popeye sound' (visual).
question: In 'Costume Contest', why does Pam's costume not make sense?
